notes.title: June 16 Update: New Achievement System
notes.content:
June 16 Update: New Achievement System

The trial version now includes 5 achievements.


About Unlocking Achievements:

If you already played a lot before this update, don't worry.
When you reach the story point "Immigration Hall Memory" (or load a save file from after this point),
the game will automatically unlock all achievements you earned in previous story progress.

notes.title: June 10 & 15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
June 10 & 15 Patch NotesJune 15 Updates
Fixed screen freeze when tapping too fast.

Fixed text errors that made story hard to understand.
June 10 Updates
Fixed some character image quality.

Fixed Japanese text not showing correctly.

Fixed Plato's page missing in English library + improved text layout.

Modified some sound effects and default sound volumes.
Important Notice
In the June 10 update, to completely fix localization display issues, we made necessary changes to the save file structure. Unfortunately, this may cause some early invited testers' save files to become unreadable. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and kindly ask for your understanding. We know save files are vital to your experience – this change was a necessary step to keep core game content working properly.

We truly value every player's support and have learned from this situation. In future updates, we will handle similar changes with double caution and do everything possible to prevent save file issues from happening again.
Coming Soon
Adjust music/sound/voice volumes.

Add achievement system.
